steps.title: Keep the supplied say/tell partners together
steps.body: The supplied infinitives говори́ть and сказа́ть form the recorded imperfective/perfective pair for the say/tell relation. The short source label beside both forms is not a promise that every meaning of speaking has the same partner. First recognize the pair; a communicative request also needs a context.

steps.title: Keep the supplied do/make partners together
steps.body: The supplied infinitives де́лать and сде́лать are the recorded imperfective/perfective do/make pair. Preserve the supplied spelling and stress. This one pair does not authorize a rule that adding any prefix makes the correct partner of any verb.

steps.title: Separate a lexical pair from an aspect decision
steps.body: Pair recognition identifies related verbs. It does not by itself decide what a speaker is requesting. The English situations below ask only for the aspect category suited to a specified communicative purpose. They do not ask you to invent a Russian sentence or prove command-form production.

steps.title: A request focused on one completed result
steps.body: For the bounded courteous request here, the speaker wants one particular finished result. Choose the perfective category. This is not a claim that every command about one occasion must use that category:insistent instructions to get started and invitations can have a different focus. Keep the stated purpose with the context.

steps.title: A request for recurring activity
steps.body: When the stated instruction concerns an activity repeated on a schedule rather than a singled-out completed result, choose the imperfective category in these situations. Read the described recurrence; do not choose from a memorized lexical partner or an answer position.

steps.title: An ordinary prohibition
steps.body: For the explicit ban in this situation, choose the imperfective category. Do not turn this into a rule that every negative command has one category. Certain warnings about an unintended event use a different pattern. The check specifies a prohibition and excludes that warning reading.
